title: Integrative Network Pharmacology and Molecular Docking Analyses on the Mechanisms of San-Zhong-Kui-Jian-Tang in Treating Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
authors: Tan, Chun Hoe; Sivakumar, Haresh; Luo, Da-Gui; Cen, Yu-Xin
one_liner_zh: 该研究用网络药理学和分子对接分析中药复方治疗口腔鳞癌的靶点，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) is an aggressive cancer with a high mortality rate. San-Zhong-Kui-Jian-Tang (SZKJT), a Chinese herbal formula, has long been used as an adjuvant therapy in cancer clinical practice. Although its therapeutic effects and molecular mechanisms in OSCC have been previously elucidated, the potential interactions and mechanisms between the active phytochemicals and their therapeutic targets are still lacking. METHODS: The present study employed network pharmacology and topology approaches to establish a "herbal ingredients-active phytochemicals-target interaction" network to explore the potential therapeutic targets of SZKJT-active phytochemicals in the treatment of OSCC. The role of the target proteins in oncogenesis was assessed via GO and KEGG enrichment analyses, and their interactions with the active phytochemicals of SZKJT were calculated via molecular docking and dynamic simulations. The pharmacokinetic properties and toxicity of the active phytochemicals were also predicted.  RESULTS: A total of 171 active phytochemicals of SZKJT fulfilled the bioavailability and drug-likeness screening criteria, with the flavonoids quercetin, kaempferol, and naringenin having the greatest potential. The 4 crucial targets of these active phytochemicals are PTGS2, TNF, BCL2, and CASP3, which encode cyclooxygenase-2, tumor necrosis factor (TNF), BCL-2 apoptosis regulator, and caspase-3, respectively. The interactions between phytochemicals and target proteins were predicted to be thermodynamically feasible and stable via molecular docking and dynamics simulations. Finally, the results revealed that the IL-6/JAK/STAT3 pathway and TNF signaling via NF-kappaB are the two prominent pathways targeted by SZKJT. CONCLUSION: In summary, this study provides computational data for in-depth exploration of the mechanism by which SZKJT activates phytochemicals to treat OSCC.
abstract_zh: 目的：口腔鳞状细胞癌（OSCC）是一种侵袭性强、死亡率高的癌症。三中葵煎汤（SZKJT）作为一种中药复方，长期在癌症临床实践中用作辅助治疗。尽管其治疗OSCC的效果和分子机制已被先前阐明，但其活性植物化学物质与治疗靶点之间的潜在相互作用和机制仍缺乏研究。方法：本研究采用网络药理学和拓扑学方法，构建“草药成分-活性植物化学物质-靶点相互作用”网络，以探索SZKJT活性植物化学物质治疗OSCC的潜在治疗靶点。通过GO和KEGG富集分析评估靶蛋白在肿瘤发生中的作用，并通过分子对接和动态模拟计算其与SZKJT活性植物化学物质的相互作用。同时预测了活性植物化学物质的药代动力学特性和毒性。结果：共有171种SZKJT活性植物化学物质符合生物利用度和类药性筛选标准，其中黄酮类化合物槲皮素、山柰酚和柚皮素潜力最大。这些活性植物化学物质的4个关键靶点为PTGS2、TNF、BCL2和CASP3，分别编码环氧化酶-2、肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）、BCL-2凋亡调节因子和半胱天冬酶-3。通过分子对接和动态模拟预测，植物化学物质与靶蛋白之间的相互作用在热力学上可行且稳定。最后，结果显示IL-6/JAK/STAT3通路和通过NF-kappaB的TNF信号传导是SZKJT靶向的两个主要通路。结论：总之，本研究为深入探索SZKJT激活植物化学物质治疗OSCC的机制提供了计算数据。
